name: proto-blocks/cadco-resource-library
title: Cadco Resource Library
description: The resource centre: filters for media type, product and text, a grid of resource cards, and pagination.

footnote.label: Note under the grid
footnote.help: Shown centred beneath the pagination, for the reader who did not find what they came for.

perPage.label: Resources per page
perPage.help: The frame shows eighteen cards, but they are the same six repeated three times; set this to what the library actually holds.

showFilters.label: Show the filters
showFilters.help: Turn off to show a plain grid, for a page that lists one kind of resource.
